edges.reason: msg.sender receives the entire initial supply balance in the constructor.
approve stores the allowance keyed by the caller msg.sender.
transfer debits and credits balances using msg.sender as the source account.
transferFrom consumes the allowance of the caller msg.sender.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter selects the allowance slot written by approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value written by approve.
to parameter is the credited account in transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount debited and credited in transfer.
from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved in transferFrom.
Constructor writes the name state variable.
Constructor writes the symbol state variable.
Constructor writes the decimals state variable.
Constructor assigns the initial _totalSupply.
Constructor mints balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] to compute circulating supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
approve writes the allowed nested mapping.
transfer reads and writes both debited and credited balance entries.
transferFrom reads and writes the from and to balance entries.
transferFrom decrements the caller allowance in the allowed mapping.
transfer performs the sender balance debit through this subtraction operation.
transfer performs the recipient balance credit through this addition operation.
transferFrom performs the source balance debit through this subtraction operation.
transferFrom decrements the allowance through this subtraction operation.
transferFrom performs the destination balance credit through this addition operation.
The checked subtraction result overwrites balances[msg.sender].
The checked addition result overwrites balances[to] in transferFrom.
The allowance subtraction result overwrites allowed[from][msg.sender].
transfer routes the balance debit through the SafeMath.safeSub helper.
transfer routes the balance credit through the SafeMath.safeAdd helper.
transferFrom routes the source balance debit through SafeMath.safeSub.
transferFrom routes the allowance decrement through SafeMath.safeSub.
transferFrom routes the destination balance credit through SafeMath.safeAdd.
